Logback 1.6.6 source availability

This distribution includes Logback Classic and Logback Core 1.6.6. The upstream
project offers Logback under either EPL-2.0 or LGPL-2.1; this distribution
selects EPL-2.0. The exact-version source archives are available from Maven
Central:

Logback Classic:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ch/qos/logback/logback-classic/1.6.6/logback-classic-1.6.6-sources.jar
SHA-256: e3a8a1a00701c54f0b23c2c1427c307e9481da6c0696a7abf3a38a77322288d0

Logback Core:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ch/qos/logback/logback-core/1.6.6/logback-core-1.6.6-sources.jar
SHA-256: 2da2e76aa79f98770ffba58311b495e0e710b8bc6f46504249d039262668fe96

The source archive bytes were resolved and verified for these exact artifact
versions. The original EPL-2.0 text is included alongside this notice.
